description: This file defines an abstract class 'MethodObject' which represents an object value in the Minilang framework of the OFBiz project. It provides abstract methods to retrieve the object, its class type, and name, used as a parameter or similar in minilang methods.

classes.name: MethodObject
classes.description: An abstract class representing an object value within the minilang framework, parameterized by type T, providing methods to obtain the value, its class, and name.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the object of type T from the method context.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the Class object corresponding to type T.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the name of the type of object.
